newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel issues permits to Palestinian journalists.
newsitem.headline: Israel issues permits to Palestinian journalists.

text.p: Israel said on Monday it would issue permits to about 120 Palestinian journalists to allow them to enter Israeli-controlled areas for their work.

"For the past few years Palestinian journalists have run into problems entering territory under Israeli control, something that makes it difficult for them to carry out their work as journalists," the prime minister's office said in a statement.
"Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered that Palestinian journalists be granted as soon as possible special entry permits," it added.
The statement said the permits were being issued to those journalists eligible under guidelines determined by the security establishment.
Palestinians complain they are unable to carry out their work and cover Israeli, as well as Palestinian issues, as a result of the ban.
The Palestinian Journalists Association has frequently called for barring Israeli journalists from entering PLO-ruled areas until they are granted freedom of access to Israeli controlled areas.
Israeli journalists may enter self-rule areas freely to cover news events.
